description: Security Event Rates, Top 25 UZAs is a dataset listed in data.transportation.gov (U.S. DOT open data portal), an open data portal of the U.S. Department of Transportation under the section "Public Transit", published or maintained by Federal Transit Administration. This dataset details safety and security events per unlinked passenger trips/vehicle revenue miles (UPT/VRM) for 5 different metrics: Major Passenger Assaults and Homicides, Major Worker Assaults and Homicides, Fatalities (safety), Fatalities (security), Fatalities (trespasser/suicide). Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Public Transit". It has 23 columns, among them vehicle_revenue_miles, value, metric_ridership_rate, metric_vehicle_revenue_hours_6mo_avg_rate, ridership_6mo_avg, Population_Num. The portal shows 2026-09-08 as the last data update. Attribution given: Federal Transit Administration. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is U.S. federal government work, public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-usdot-data-transportation-gov-portal.
